english.title: Throw, drop etc object capable of injuring / endangering person / damaging property in Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), placed, threw, dropped or trailed an object, namely **(..SPECIFY OBJECT..), capable of injuring, endangering any person or damaging any property in the

(A)_[Blackwall]_
(B)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel area
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(2) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
